subject: English
guide_solution: (a) ICT means information and communication technology. In education sector ICT works as a means of class presentation. (b) In health science ICT is used to diagnose disease and give good treat= (c) Teachers use ICT to take multimedia classes. (d) Patients can get treatment through telemedicine which is run with the help of (e) ICT.
